definitions.direction: Second side broken or second orange target touched. Same-bar order is excluded. U/D studies are separate.
definitions.reference: Frozen high and low of [previous19:30,08:30). At checkpoint use latest completed five-minute close; forward movement starts at checkpoint opening price.
definitions.windows: Future bars [checkpoint,end). No endpoint-opening candle included. New extreme must break the entire known19:30-to-checkpoint extreme.
definitions.reversal: A close back across the relevant frozen08:30 edge is only a return if that edge was breached AFTER08:30 and BEFOREcheckpoint. Merely above the overnight low is not itself a reversal.
definitions.control: All complete days without a04:30 double break, measured separately in U and D. Unmatched descriptive control; no causal adjustment.
definitions.orange: Only03–05 or05–08:30 completed events. Never condition morning outcomes on08:30–16:00 orange completion (future leakage). Sparse fit1 and fit50 shown separately.
definitions.limits: No news-event attribution, no costs or entry/stop strategy tested. Same dates may appear in multiple event families. Exploratory full-history estimates, not validated forecasts.
